sessions.view.follow.description: Button over a running session's transcript: keeps showing new messages as they arrive. Keep it short.

sessions.view.followTip.defaultMessage: Follow new messages as they arrive (Settings → Sessions sets the default)
sessions.view.followTip.description: Tooltip of Follow over a running session's transcript, while off. Settings → Sessions is where: use its translated names.

sessions.view.following.description: At the end of a running session's transcript while Follow is on.

sessions.view.followingTip.defaultMessage: Following new messages as they arrive. Click to stop.
sessions.view.followingTip.description: Tooltip of Follow over a running session's transcript, while on.

sessions.view.handedOver.description: A badge over a transcript: another agent's work was handed over to this session. Lower case; keep it short.

sessions.view.handedOverTip.defaultMessage: Another agent's work was handed over to this session. Click to open that session.
sessions.view.handedOverTip.description: Hover of the handed over badge over a transcript: the session it continues from.

sessions.view.ranIn.description: Over a transcript, before where the session ran (its agent and the project folder or a worktree).

sessions.view.refresh.description: Tooltip over a transcript: reads it again for new messages.

sessions.view.running.description: A badge over a running session's transcript. Keep it short.

sessions.view.thinking.description: A folded part of a transcript: the agent's thinking. Keep it short.

sessions.view.usage.defaultMessage: {context} context · {output} output · {prompts, plural, one {# prompt} other {# prompts}}{compactions, plural, =0 {} one { · # compaction} other { · # compactions}}{cache, select, warm { · cache warm {left}} expired { · cache expired} other {}}
sessions.view.usage.description: Over a transcript: its context and output tokens ("120K"), how many prompts the user sent, how many times it was compacted (none: leave it empty), and whether the provider's prompt cache is still warm for {left} ("4m") or has expired, so resuming re-caches the conversation (not known: leave it empty).

sessions.view.you.description: The heading of the user's own message in a transcript. Keep it short.
